ns2:section.sectionText: Enrollment restricted to current actuarial science majors April 2 - April 23. Class will be unrestricted during business hours the morning of April 24, 2018. Prospective transfers should review https://math.illinois.edu/system/files/inline-files/transfer-to-actsci-ui-only.pdf Prospective transfers who are not able to register on April 24 should fill out the form here by August 23 to be added to the request list: http://go.illinois.edu/MATH210FA18 After August 23, please send name, netid, 9-digit UIN, and reason for request to mathadvising@illinois.edu.
